title: The Letters of William Herle Project (Edition 2)
author: William Herle
institution: AHRC Centre for Editing Lives and Letters, Queen Mary University of London (Robyn Adams, editor; Alison Wiggins, director)
region: England; letters also sent from the Low Countries and Germany
notes: Hypertext edition of the letters of Elizabethan intelligencer and diplomat William Herle, with a transcript of each (web page and PDF), a catalogue entry, indexes by date, sender, recipient, place and first line, a word search, and sample images. 302 letters, dated 1559 to 1588, so the whole resource lies in the period. Edition 2 was released in March 2006 and the content shows no change since; the server's file dates (2025) reflect migration only. Free for personal use; commercial use needs permission (all rights reserved). Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
